Not a card for everyone, but IMO it’s differentiated enough from the Plat and the CSR to make it compelling for a certain group of people.

Feels like its main competition will be the VX comboed with the Savor.
VX is more no-muss-no-fuss; only one coupon to use, effectively AF neutral, C1’s proprietary lounge network, primary auto CDW, price match guarantee on the portal.
CSE requires a little more work but may offer more value if (a) comboed with the Strata Premier and DC and (b) depending on your location/spend habits.

Pros:
-Unlike the Plat and CSR which are mostly useful to super-frequent travelers, the CSE caters more towards travelers who don’t travel much but splurge when they do
-Coupons are much better than anything on the Plat or CSR, especially the Splurge Credit, which is very easy to use. The Citi Travel credit is alright; some people complain about the Citi portal, but the prices on there that I saw were pretty comparable to what I saw with direct booking (caveat: I usually stay at midscale properties, not aspirational ones). A lot of people saying that the 2-night minimum is a deal-breaker; I really don’t get that either.
-Admiral’s Club access makes this a good card for people who are captive at AA hubs but who don’t travel enough to make chasing status or getting the Executive Card worth it, but are at airports where there are limited PP options (ORD notably).
-AAdvantage transfer (at 1:1!!) at least until this inevitably devalues the program
-Like BofA Preferred Rewards, legitimately feels rewarding for HNW clients who are loyal to Citi
-Still allows 2 guests with its Priority Pass membership (if you luck out and the lounge isn’t overcrowded)

Cons:
-Secondary auto rental CDW (unless in a foreign country) is pretty crappy for a card with an AF at this level
-Unclear what the exact perks for World Legend MC are at this juncture, and also unclear whether MC will even enforce the perks, given that it doesn’t for World Elite
-Dashlane is kinda eh, although tips are NOT expected unlike with Uber/Lyft
